New Features
- Added official support for A10Mini V4 (Thanks to Dmussi for important stability fixes).
- Added Yabadabadoo 32-bit libretro core for Saturn emulation.
- Added armGBA libretro core for Game Boy, Game Boy Advance, and Game Boy Color (Thanks to MagnominusGit).
- Added DSperate Nintendo DS emulator (Thanks to Noxwell for creating this emulator).
- Added Turkish translation for EmulationStation (Thanks to Natgho).
- Added SDL3 shim (Thanks to bmdhacks).

Improvements
- Replaced yabasanshiro with yabasanshiro-pirry (Thanks to pirrypirrypirry for the improved and updated source code).
- Reduced bootup time by 1.5 seconds (Thanks to cino893 for the tip).
- Updated Daphne script to launch compatible games (e.g., Dragon's Lair) using the fastboot option.
- Updated Spanish translation for EmulationStation (Thanks to gregodadone).
- Updated Linapple standalone emulator (Thanks to Slayer366).
- Updated ScummVM standalone to 2026.4.0.
- Updated Solarus to 2.1.14.
- Updated batteryplus.
- Updated nes-box and sagabox themes (Thanks to Jetup13).

Bug Fixes
- Fixed 90Hz and 120Hz support for Miniloong Pocket 1.
- Fixed RetroArch and RetroArch32 HDMI audio on RK3566 (Thanks to DanielJafari for reporting the issue).
